description: Maps deterministic takeoff geometry to the stable M01-M40 / D01-D12 vocabulary. Every divisor, spacing and per-leaf count below is a visible parameter derived from the catalog text of the item it feeds (see 'basis'). NOTHING here is read from any private answer key. The ruleset ships as a DRAFT: no price may be released until a named estimator approves this exact file (its sha256) at the Scope Gate. Fitting counts (bands, ties, caps, sleeves, hardware) are the part most in need of that review.

families.basis: Catalog: M01 2-7/8 in OD terminal/corner/gate, M02 2-3/8 in OD line, M19 120 in fabric, M12 118 in bar, M24 tie for 2-3/8 in post, M06 'Type A'.
Catalog: M03 2-3/8 in OD terminal, M04 1-7/8 in OD line, M20 42 in fabric, M13 40 in bar, M25 tie for 1-7/8 in post.

basis_notes.M05_M06: Top rail runs continuously across gate openings when the drawings say so (a scope fact, never assumed): rail length = gross run length, not net fabric length. A mid rail at 5 ft crosses an opening only if the gate leaf is not taller than the rail elevation; the 7 ft leaf occupies it, so mid rail stays net.
basis_notes.M09_M10: Brace bands: ONE band per side of a brace assembly, TWO per assembly (one terminal-side M09, one line-post-side M10). Owner decision, Jordan, 2026-10-16 2:15 PM CT; replaces the earlier two-per-side rule (version 1.2.0).
basis_notes.M06_brace: Brace rail at terminals is the mid rail (catalog text for M06), so brace LF is not added on top of M06.
basis_notes.M35: Header rail runs across each opening at the gate head; it is a different member from the top rail above the transom, so it is not netted against M05.
basis_notes.M40: Volume = pi * (d/2)^2 * depth per footing from footing facts in the documents; nothing is assumed when they are absent. Gross volume, no post displacement credit.

citations.tension_bands: 2.3.C: one full-height tension bar at each terminal, corner and gate post; tension bands 12 in maximum spacing
citations.fabric_ties: 3.4.B: fabric to line posts at 12 in on center; to rails and tension wire at 24 in on center
citations.mid_rail_bracing: 3.3.B: Type A mid rail at 5'-0"; horizontal brace rail and diagonal truss rod at each terminal and gate post, in each direction at corners; 3.3.C Type B no mid rail or bracing
citations.top_rail: 3.3.A: top rail continuous through line posts (continuity across gate openings is NOT stated here; it stays a fact to be established)
citations.post_caps: 2.1.D: pressed steel dome, one per post
citations.gates: 2.5: 1.900 in frame; header rail 1.660 in with 36 in fixed fabric above; one truss rod per leaf; 3 hinges per leaf; fork latch; one hold-back per leaf. Addendum 01 1.4: double-leaf gate also needs a center drop rod with ground sockets, fork latch on the active leaf
citations.windscreen: 2.6.A: grommets at 12 in on center along top and bottom hems; one cable tie per grommet
citations.core_drilling: 32 31 13 3.2.E: core drill every footing hole through pavement and base: one core-drill unit per footing hole
citations.tax: Section 00 0800 SC-3.6.1: owner exempt from sales and use tax on materials incorporated into the Work
citations.labor: Section 00 0800 SC-3.4: Davis-Bacon; the wage decision lists no fence erector classification; classification must be stated in the bid and an unlisted one needs agency conformance
citations.drop_rod: Addendum 01 1.4: center drop rod with ground sockets on the double-leaf gate. Spec silent on the number of sockets: draft uses 1 per rod (estimator question)
citations.fence_guard: Special Conditions item 16: fence guard on the top rail of the Type B divider, full length, per linear foot
